results.why: K11 and K13 both score whether the contribution is genuinely original versus a renamed or routine recombination of existing techniques, which is the core of the target, though they capture the explicit positioning-against-prior-work element only implicitly.

No candidate scores the composite of interpreting findings against objectives/prior evidence, weighing alternative explanations, and articulating implications; K30 and K47 cover only the restraint/limitation fragment and K10 only the interpretation of numbers.

Same composite problem as T02: contextualization with prior work, separating speculation, and stating implications are spread across fragments (K30, K47, K37) with no single candidate substitutable for the whole property.

K30 scores exactly whether conclusions stay inside what the evidence demonstrates versus using narrow evidence for sweeping claims, which is the target's claim-evidence calibration and epistemic humility, minus its causal-fallacy/confounder specifics.

Both candidates score originality versus incremental relabeling, matching the target's non-incrementality core; the significance/utility half is only partially reflected (K55/K48 score impact but a different property).

Nothing in the candidate bank scores accessibility, inclusive language, disability accommodation, or multilingual materials; K16's plain-language clause is about explaining a mechanism, a different property.

This candidate cluster scores whether stated theory actually motivates the method and is tested rather than sitting decoratively alongside it, which is the target's 'theory does real work and coheres with the findings', though the candidates presuppose formal results while the target also admits non-formal conceptual framing.

K34 scores whether the dataset's scale, composition, and coverage are actually characterized rather than merely named, overlapping the target's composition/coverage documentation, though it does not score provenance, timeframe, filtering, or representativeness.
K37 scores whether the text reads as one organized, comprehensible argument versus a fragmented list of disconnected assertions, which is the target's clarity/organization property in ML register.

The target's core is faithful, complete coverage of background/methods/results/conclusions without hype; candidates split this into disjoint fragments (K31 hype only, K50 density only, K37 flow only) and none is substitutable for the whole.
No candidate scores reference currency, accuracy, fair representation of sources, or self-citation ethics.
Both candidates score whether resource cost and the resulting quality/accuracy consequence are quantified rather than asserted, which is the target's compute-efficiency trade-off reporting.
No candidate addresses reporting-guideline (STROBE/RECORD) adherence for observational study designs.

K57 scores exactly whether a specific, verifiable code/data/artifact availability commitment with a destination is given versus a vague promise or nothing, matching the target's availability statement with access details.
The target bundles title specificity and keyword/controlled-vocabulary quality with abstract quality, and no candidate scores titles or keywords at all.
K26 is topically adjacent (re-auditing existing work) but scores empirical re-benchmarking of methods, not the search/selection/synthesis methodology and reporting of a literature review.
